sahneler.metin: Holding in freezing rain, a turboprop suddenly rolled over.
It crashed into a field in Indiana, and sixty eight people were killed.
Ice had built up on its wings.
Its de-icing boots cracked off ice at the front.
But large droplets froze just behind them.
That ridge disturbed the airflow over the ailerons.
The controls snatched, and the plane rolled.
Icing certification later expanded to cover these droplets.

aciklama:
American Eagle 4184 rolled over and crashed while holding in freezing rain. The cause: supercooled large droplets forming ice beyond the protected area, disturbing airflow over the ailerons.

#shorts #engineering #aviation
